diagrams.title: From capability to hosted tool
diagrams.summary: A portable capability is defined before it is bound to an implementation and resolved by a host.

nodes.label: Definition
nodes.description: Identity, scope, and contributions are declared.

nodes.label: Registry
nodes.description: The module is admitted and indexed.

nodes.label: Resolution
nodes.description: The host selects the required contribution.

nodes.label: Hosting
nodes.description: The surface mounts the tool without owning its domain.

diagrams.caption: Resolving or displaying a tool does not transfer authority over its definition.
